purpose: Release-time values that the generated LGPL source offer (share/licenses/SOURCE-OFFER.md) needs and that cannot be derived from a build: where a recipient asks, and for how long. Also the owner's decision whether the Web stage (06-web) may be published as a final release (web_public_release; default: not approved). Everything else (tag, commit, upstream archives and hashes, patches) is derived at build or release time by tools/crt_source_offer.py.

web_public_release.approved_by: webos21 (repository owner; explicit approval in chat)
accepted_blockers: native three-host and cross-target packaging acceptance required
web_public_release.note: Owner approval recorded 2026-10-22 closes Tranche 10 using the linked three-host isolated SDK and Linux/aarch64 cross-build evidence in docs/acceptance/crtweb_acceptance.md. The accepted packaging blocker is the advisory tool's fixed reminder, not a waiver of failed security checks, a stale pin or an expired support grace period. Retain the documented VM/device and relink limits. The owner removed the v0.4.0-preview.1 binary release; its source tag remains. This approval does not republish old development SDKs or upload a new release: new artifacts must record this decision, pass fresh release-time checks and include the required notices and corresponding source. approved=true needs approved_by and approved_utc; any other unaccepted blocker keeps a build a development candidate.
